en: Je m’appelle tells someone your name.
How do you say “My name is Tom” in French?
To give your name, say je m’appelle and then your name.
How do you ask “What is your name?” in French?
Comment tu t’appelles ? asks a friend’s name. Comment ça va ? asks how they are.
J’ai … ans tells your age. Sept is seven.
How do you say “I am six years old” in French?
In French you “have” your years: j’ai six ans.
How do you ask “How old are you?” in French?
Quel âge means what age, so Quel âge as-tu ? asks how old you are.
Comment ça va ? asks how someone is.
What does “Ça va bien, merci” mean?
Bien means well and merci means thank you.
How do you say “I’m not well” in French?
Ne… pas means not, so ça ne va pas means I’m not well.
Où means where, and est means is.
What does “Où est le chat ?” mean?
Où est means where is, and le chat is the cat.
How do you ask “Where are the toilets?” in French?
Où sont means where are, and les toilettes are the toilets.
How do you ask “Where is my bag?” in French?
Où est means where is, and mon sac is my bag.
Bonjour is how you say hello in the daytime.
Someone asks “Comment tu t’appelles ?”. What do you answer?
They asked your name, so you say je m’appelle and your name.
Someone asks “Quel âge as-tu ?”. What do you answer?
They asked your age, so you answer j’ai … ans.
Someone asks “Comment ça va ?”. What do you answer?
They asked how you are, so you say ça va bien, merci.
Et means and, and toi means you.
La nuit is the night, so bonne nuit means good night.
What does “Salut !” mean to a friend?
Salut is a friendly hi. Friends can also use it to say bye.
How do you say “See you soon!” in French?
Bientôt means soon, so à bientôt means see you soon.
Fill the gap: Je m’___ Hugo.
To give your name, say je m’appelle: Je m’appelle Hugo.
Fill the gap: J’___ neuf ans.
For your age French uses j’ai: J’ai neuf ans.
Léo says “J’ai dix ans.” How old is Léo?
Dix means ten, so Léo is 10.
Mia says “Je m’appelle Mia et j’ai cinq ans.” How old is Mia?
Cinq means five, so Mia is 5.
What does “Où est la piscine ?” mean?
Où est means where is, and la piscine is the swimming pool.
Très means very and bien means good or well.
How do you say “Thank you very much” in French?
Beaucoup means a lot, so merci beaucoup is thank you very much.
Your friend looks sad. What do you ask?
Ça va ? asks if your friend is all right.

example.why_en: Je m’appelle tells someone your name.

en.title: Talking about me in French
en.teach: Say who you are in French: Je m’appelle Sam (My name is Sam). J’ai sept ans (I am seven). Ask Comment ça va ? (How are you?) and Où est… ? (Where is…?).
